case.title: Exempla Holding AG impersonation — crypto investment fraud (demo case)
case.summary: Perpetrators impersonated Exempla Holding AG (UID CHE-000.000.000, Musterstadt) via exempla-holding.example and the persona 'Adrian Example, CFO'. On 12 Oct 2026 at 10:49:47 UTC the victim sent 399,247.92 USDC (origin tx 0x70ab…a814) from 0x7AC3…455b to 0x57de…F8df, a perpetrator wallet reached through a perpetrator-registered ENS lure name. The USDC was relayed 0x57de → 0x3007 → 0x0d0b → 0xba02 → 0xe944 (arrived 11:07:35 UTC); 0xe944 is perpetrator-controlled and itself swapped USDC → ETH on Uniswap, then sent 156.611 ETH to the hub 0x5445…becb at 11:09:59 UTC. The hub split it within 90 minutes: 53.94 ETH → 0xc6a2…d5a1, 39.15 ETH → 0x9cf8…42c1, 8.77 ETH → 0x2501…57e3 (the wallet the investigator's reports call the scammers' wallet), and on 16 Oct 27.9 ETH was swapped to USDT via the Uniswap Universal Router. 0x2501… still held 5.04 ETH on 19 Oct. Downstream touchpoints: KuCoin, Rainbet, SWFT swaps to USDT-TRON and BTC. Relay-hop hashes are pending on-chain verification.
